svg.title: Fork ecosystem
svg.desc: Fork Studio, Fork Music, the cloud, the P2P network and the phone. 18 components and 17 flows.
svg.text: Fork Studio, Fork Music, the cloud, the P2P network and the phone

g.title: Fork Studio — Built — Producer app: projects, samples, signed versions, store, network and phone access.
Fork Music — Built — Fan app: store, library, passes, encrypted delivery and the shared player.
Fork Labels — Built — Label management app: releases, submissions, contracts and payouts.
Fork Manager — Built — Management app: gigs, invoices, press, riders, social and accounts.
Fork Events — Planned — Event manager app; only the shared shell and an empty page exist.
Phone browser — Built — Connect PWA and Studio /m: browse projects, palette, samples and send files over P2P.
Supabase — Built — Postgres, Auth, Storage and Realtime: accounts, projects, versions, store and swarm records.
Edge Functions — Built — Server-side functions: checkout, webhook, settle, certs, invites, verify and wallet.
forkgate.io site — Built — Landing, beta signup, protocol survey, verify and licence pages, admin and /download.
Fork Admin — Built — Admin dashboard: development status, architecture, traffic, reports, signer, QA and support.
/connect PWA — Built — Installable phone web app: Studio tunnel, swarm reader and file upload.
P2P swarm — Building — Encrypted blocks on Fork computers and phones, three copies, direct transfers and release seeding.
fork-relay — Building — Circuit relay and rendezvous for NAT traversal; code exists, no server deployed.
fork-signer — Built — Hot licence signer: Stripe queue, serials, Solana mint/transfer/freeze and key release; off by default.
Stripe — Building — Checkout, Tax and Connect Express payouts; test mode and the checkout switch is off.
Solana devnet — Building — Bubblegum v2 licences in one MPL Core collection; devnet only, no mainnet.
GitHub release feeds — Building — Signed updater feeds and installers; the public feed repositories are still to create.
fork-backup — Building — Daily encrypted database dump spread over the swarm and a local folder; off by default.

svg.text: ON THE COMPUTER AND THE PHONE
